name: cache-shot-clock
description: A shot clock for the prompt cache's TTL: a small countdown in the bar under the prompt, and a big LED clock above it for the last seconds before the next turn pays a full cache write.

bigAt.title: Big clock at (seconds left)
bigAt.description: The LED clock appears above the prompt from this many seconds left until just after the buzzer; 0 keeps it to the bar under the prompt.

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: auto reads it from the session transcript; 5m or 1h forces it.

warnSeconds.title: Warn at (seconds left)
warnSeconds.description: Toast when the idle cache has this many seconds left; 0 turns the toast off.

testTtlSeconds.title: Test TTL (seconds)
testTtlSeconds.description: For testing: count down from this many seconds instead of the real TTL. 0 is off. It does not change how long the cache really lasts.
